spellList.effect: 2024: range is 15 feet, and at level 5 the cantrip upgrade doubles it to 30 feet. A creature at 0 HP that is not dead becomes Stable.

spellList.effect: One object that is not worn or carried sheds light for 1 hour.

spellList.name: Bless
spellList.effect: Domain. Concentration, 1 minute. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spellList.effect: Domain. 2024: 2d8 + Wisdom modifier (3) HP. Disciple of Life adds 3. Upcast +2d8 per slot above 1st. This is not the 2014 1d8.

spellList.name: Healing Word
spellList.effect: Magic Initiate spell, always prepared. A creature regains hit points. Use the 2024 text at the table if you upcast; the free casting is 1st level.

spellList.name: Shield of Faith
spellList.effect: Concentration. +2 AC.

spellList.name: Guiding Bolt
spellList.effect: Spell attack +6. On a hit, radiant damage and the next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

spellList.name: Command
spellList.effect: One-word command. Wisdom save DC 14 or the target follows it on its next turn.

spellList.name: Lesser Restoration
spellList.effect: Domain. 2024 casting time is a Bonus Action. End Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. It does not say it ends a disease.

spellList.name: Aid
spellList.effect: Domain. 8 hours. Three creatures gain 5 current and maximum HP at 2nd level.

spellList.name: Hold Person
spellList.effect: Concentration, 1 minute. Wisdom save DC 14 or the Paralyzed condition. Repeat at the end of each turn.

spellList.name: Revivify
spellList.effect: Domain. A creature that died within the last minute returns with 1 HP. Consumes a diamond worth 300+ GP. Cannot restore a missing body part or reverse death from old age.

spellList.name: Mass Healing Word
spellList.effect: Domain. Up to six creatures regain hit points.

spellList.name: Dispel Magic
spellList.effect: End a spell of 3rd level or lower. Higher: ability check DC 10 + the spell's level.

spellList.name: Spirit Guardians
spellList.effect: Concentration, 10 minutes. Damage and speed penalty in the emanation. Wisdom save DC 14.

characters.conversionNote: 2024 Life Domain spells at cleric 5 are Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Mass Healing Word, and Revivify. Spiritual Weapon and Beacon of Hope are not on that domain list.

Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage if the target is missing any Hit Points. After a Short or Long Rest you may switch this to Horde Breaker.
Extra Attack: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
Alert: Add proficiency (+3) to Initiative. Already in +6. You may swap Initiative with one willing ally who is not Incapacitated.

Resourceful / Skillful / Versatile: Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest. Perception is the extra skill. Alert is the background feat, so Versatile was not a second origin feat. Human gives one origin feat only if the background did not already; this sheet does not stack a second origin feat.
